name: The Black Shield

chain: The Shady Rest Inn quest chain

summary: At the burned Shady Rest Inn, a fire-blackened shield hangs from the crumbling chimney. Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore awaits evidence from the ruins.

sections.title: A Shield on the Chimney
sections.body: Few parts of the burned Shady Rest Inn remain beyond a crumbling chimney. A fire-blackened iron shield is still fixed to its brick, and can be removed. Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore awaits evidence from the inn site.

sections.title: The Captain's Verdict
sections.body: Captain Garran Vimes knows how arms and armor are used, though he does not claim to know how they are made. The shield looks ordinary to him, save for the damage left by the fire.

faq.q: Where is the black shield located?
faq.answer: The black shield is fixed to the brick of the crumbling chimney, one of the few parts of the burned Shady Rest Inn still standing.

faq.q: Who wants evidence from the Shady Rest Inn?
faq.answer: Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore wants evidence from the Shady Rest Inn ruins.
